name: datashare
description: DataShare monorepo: NestJS back-end, React front-end and the package they share

scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov -w back -w front && node scripts/coverage-global.mjs
scripts.e2e: START_SERVER_AND_TEST_INSECURE=1 start-server-and-test e2e:back tcp:localhost:3001 e2e:front https-get://localhost:8081 e2e:run
scripts.e2e:open: START_SERVER_AND_TEST_INSECURE=1 start-server-and-test e2e:back tcp:localhost:3001 e2e:front https-get://localhost:8081 e2e:ui
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
